about: Iannella and Mummolo works from Chestnut Street in Newton and names four attorneys. Its site is the fastest in this market by a distance, and the only one here that passes Core Web Vitals outright.

688 reviews at 4.4, the lowest average of the larger firms in this ranking. It states no fee model and no free consultation in terms we could record, and it publishes its injury practice at an address our practice check could not find from its sitemap, so a person confirmed it by hand.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

G1.evidence: Massachusetts does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Judicial Court of Massachusetts on the discipline of attorneys, on the recommendation of the Board of Bar Overseers, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 168 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Judicial Court of Massachusetts on the discipline of attorneys, on the recommendation of the Board of Bar Overseers, 1975 to 2025. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. Massachusetts publishes no business register we can query. The Secretary of the Commonwealth's corporate search answers a request for its robots file with a 403 and its search page with a redirect loop, and the state runs no open data portal carrying the register. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 4 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 688 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2000-11-28, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

score.verdict: All 5 eligibility gates passed. Certification needs more of the scale measured than we have managed here, pillar A in particular. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
